disclosure: During the R54 derivation, after the original 142 matched-limit runs, a direct SUBSET SUM reduction and a per-history component-packing extension were obtained. This addendum is committed before any reduction-validation or hardness-challenge execution. The original study inputs, outcomes, limits, and immutable protocol are unchanged. The added cases are deliberately structural stress cases, not an unseen operational sample.
reduction: For positive integer weights w_i, total A, target W, n histories, set K=n^2 A, l_i=(i-1)/n, z_i=l_i+w_i/(n A), pi_i=1/n, b_i=tau_i=z_i, f(x)=x, h_i=0. The 2n-command catalog has free l_i and charges w_i/(2K) for z_i; m=2n. Put D0=sum pi_i l_i and B=D0+W/K. With all free commands installed, a subset of weight s has value D0+W/(2K)-abs(s-W)/(2K). Thus attaining D0+W/(2K) is equivalent to SUBSET SUM.

checks: every optional subset against exact original allocation and distance formula

challenge.target: nearest odd integer at or above floor(A/2)
challenge.limits: unchanged four-second and two-GiB address-space limits; for uniform and class-box use requested epsilon 1/(8K) and explicitly label that comparison; exact optimal value independently obtained by integer subset-sum dynamic programming for these constructed cases

packing_extension: Additional development checks may verify the heterogeneous-reward component-packing identity. They are labeled as post-derivation checks, not additions to the frozen unseen-regression count. A new heterogeneous uniform-grid implementation is not claimed to have been benchmarked.
